# conversations.ChatRequest

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

One chat turn: the member's message (or approval responses) sent to the assistant, answered as a UI message stream.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `conversations.ChatRequest` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |
| Permission | `core.conversation.send` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agentId` | no | `none` | Chat agent of a new conversation (default assistant). |  |
| `attachments` | no | `none` | Ready chat-attachment files of the caller to add to a user turn. |  |
| `conversationId` | no | `none` | Existing conversation; a new one is created when absent. |  |
| `message` | yes | `personal` | The last message of the chat. |  |
| `organizationId` | no | `none` | Organization of a new conversation. |  |
| `projectId` | no | `none` | Project of a new conversation; organization level when absent. |  |
| `trigger` | no | `none` | useChat trigger. |  |
